newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Index vols aloft as stocks sag.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Index vols aloft as stocks sag.

text.p: Implied volatilities for U.S. stock index options stayed aloft as stock prices fluctuated mostly in negative territory in followthrough to Friday's selloff, traders said.

International Business Machines Corp's earnings report due out after today's market close and Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony on Tuesday and Wednesday also buoyed volatilities and kept trading volume relatively low, they added.
A typical post-expiration lethargy after July options expiration at the end of last week also subdued volume.
